column2: I-Kumkaj luphawu lwee-app zeenkqubo zokusebenza zeshishini ezibambekayo — isoftware epheleleyo yolawulo lweshishini esebenza kwizixhobo zakho. Imveliso nganye yakhelwe umsebenzi omnye: iipasile, indawo yokutyela, ivenkile yokutya, ikhemesti.
Akukho nto kule khawuntara ilindele ilifu.
Skrola okanye usebenzise amachaphaza ukuze utsibele phakathi kwamacandelo.
Idesika yomsebenzi ngamnye.\nHayi i-app enye eneqhosha lokutshintsha.
Hayi i-app enye eneqhosha lokutshintsha umsebenzi. Imveliso nganye iyilwe ngohlobo olunye lwekhawuntara, ngamagama aloo msebenzi uqobo.

Iintengiso, amaqabane nencwadi yosuku zibhalwa kwisixhobo esikwikhawuntara yakho — hayi kwiseva oyiqeshileyo.
Yonke intengiso, intlawulo nedokethi zigcinwa kwikhompyutha okanye kwitablethi onayo.
Yifake uze uqalise. Akukho kubhalisa, akukho khadi ligciniweyo.
Gcina ikopi yogcino nanini na uthanda. Yifayile, kwaye yeyakho.
Iikhawuntara neetablethi ezongezelelweyo ziqhagamshela nge-Wi-Fi yakho — ngaphandle kwe-intanethi phakathi.
Ii-app ze-Kumkaj azifuni kuqhagamshelana neseva yethu ukuze zisebenze. Nqumla i-intanethi uze ubukele okutshintshayo kwikhawuntara.
Izinto eziphuma evenkileni, njengerisithi ye-WhatsApp, zisafuna i-intanethi ukuze zifike.
Akukho ntlawulo ngesihlalo, umsebenzisi, itafile, umhambisi, ipasile okanye isixhobo. Ayilovavanyo.
Hlawulela kuphela oko ukusebenzisayo — amaxabiso afanayo kumntu wonke.
Ilifu licwangcisiwe kwaye lingokuzikhethela. Ikhawuntara isebenza ngaphandle kwalo.

Uluhlu olufanayo lweelwimi ezili-115 njengazo zonke ii-app ze-Kumkaj — isiArabhu nesiUrdu ukusuka ekunene ukuya ekhohlo. Amagama emveli angezantsi; imizekelo ye-“Ukutya kulungile” ngesiHindi, isiGujarati, isiTamil, isiBengali, isiUrdu nesiNgesi:
Injini efanayo yokwakha umbhalo njengee-app, ukuze oonobumba abadityanisiweyo nemigca yasekunene-ukuya-ekhohlo iphume kakuhle.
Iipasile · indawo yokutyela · ivenkile yokutya · ikhemesti
Idesika yeepasile — bhukisha, faka ilebheli, nikezela, gqibezela imali.
Inkqubo yendawo yokutyela — itafile, ikhitshi, ibhili, ukuvala usuku.
Ikhawuntara yevenkile yokutya — thengisa, incwadi yamatyala, isitokhwe, incwadi yosuku.
Ikhawuntara yekhemesti — ibhetshi, ukuphelelwa, ibhili, ukuvala usuku.
I-intanethi ivaliwe — kwaye akukho nto itshintshileyo kwikhawuntara.
Imveliso nganye ye-Kumkaj ine-akhawunti yayo (nelifu layo). Khetha umsebenzi owenzayo — ukungena nokuhlawula kuhlala kwisayithi yaloo mveliso.

Izicwangciso zelifu zonyaka — iintlobo ezintlanu ezifanayo zawo onke umsebenzi (Simahla ngonaphakade, Steady ₹6 000, Swift ₹12 000, Priority ₹24 000 / ngonyaka ngaphandle kwerhafu, okanye uqikelelo lwexabiso olwenziwe ngokwezifiso). Irhafu yongezwa xa uhlawula. Imveliso nganye igcina ivenkile yayo ne-akhawunti yayo.
